|game_text=Deploy on [[Coruscant: ISB Central Office{{!}}ISB Central Office]]. This site is a prison (if opponent controls, all captives here are released). Total ability of 6 or more required for opponent to draw battle destiny here. Whenever an ISB agent delivers a captive here, opponent loses 4 Force (once per captive per captivity). ISB agents may escort captives and, if escorting a captive during your move phase, may use 1 Force to relocate escort and captive to a related docking bay (as a regular move). Once during your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate (as a regular move) an ISB agent present with [[Ice-Heart]] here to a site you control.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[In The Hands Of The ISB (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The image is the Virtual Block 7 release-sheet slip, which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-inthehandsoftheisb-pre.gif]]) shows the errata text and is on [[In The Hands Of The ISB (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010), the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1271_27-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[In The Hands Of The ISB (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “with Ice-Heart here” to “with Ysanne Isard here”. The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), had already made it a Mission: "This card is no longer considered to be a Critical Mission."<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-12; PDF created by 27 August 2012. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref><ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's Virtual Set 7.3 release news of 4 June 2011 already pointed players to “the most recent errata to Rogue Insertion (V) and In The Hands Of The ISB (V)” and to “the current rules change regarding Mission types”<ref name="pcnews-7_3">Players Committee news “Virtual Set 7.3 Released!”, 4 June 2011, in the site news feed as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20110728061702/http://starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=1&Itemid=117&format=feed&type=rss 28 July 2011] (Internet Archive)</ref>. The forum post with that errata is not archived, so a middle version (no longer a Critical Mission, still “Ice-Heart”) probably existed from about June 2011, but its wording is unknown and it is not listed as a version.
